title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Wednesday, 23 September 2026
description: Today: Anthropic's Dario Amodei details a 'pace the frontier' AI safety plan as over 100 tech firms sign a joint cyber-defence letter; tributes flow for children's author Terry Denton as a super-for-housing proposal reignites debate; a dangerous bushfire threatens homes at Teelah in the South Burnett; and the Gold Coast Suns brace for a pivotal AFL trade period. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).
